patterns.note: Full-width content sections are frequently broken up by full-bleed background colors or gradients, creating distinct visual blocks.
Product and collection displays utilize horizontal scrolling carousels to showcase multiple items within a compact area.
A vibrant and diverse color palette is used, featuring bright purples, teals, pinks, and greens, often in gradients, against a predominantly white background.
The hero image background elements exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground text and CTA, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections reveal with a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Headings use a bold, condensed sans-serif typeface, often highlighting key words or phrases with a contrasting accent color.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a background image that scrolls at a slower pace than the overlaying text and call-to-action, achieving a subtle parallax effect that adds visual depth.

Content sections are progressively revealed as the user scrolls down the page, appearing with a soft fade and a slight upward movement, likely orchestrated by a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll combined with CSS keyframes.
Product and collection galleries are implemented as horizontal carousels, allowing users to navigate through items by swiping or clicking, powered by a library like Swiper.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) are paired with a clean, regular-weight sans-serif for body copy and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (~4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, product cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing separates major content sections, while product grids maintain a more compact but clear arrangement.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its energetic and playful use of a broad, vibrant color palette and gradients, particularly in section backgrounds and interactive elements like the color wheel. This bold approach, combined with modern, impactful typography, creates a highly engaging and memorable brand experience that feels fresh and dynamic.
